title: Craftable rare items
description: This simple data pack adds crafting recipes for some rare items.
body:
Are you frustrated that some rare items in my world are hard to obtain? Why is it that I just want a name tag or a saddle, but have to search through chests everywhere? Why can there only be one dragon egg in each world? Why is the trident, a useful weapon, so difficult to get?  
Don't worry, with this simple data pack, I have added crafting recipes for these rare items. From now on, you can mass-produce these rare items!
